# v3.7 — CSS Custom Properties Guide This file demonstrates how all colors, spacing, and visual elements are controlled through CSS custom properties (`--var`). ## Core Theme Variables ```css :root { --bg: #0a0c12; /* Main background */ --surface: #161b22; /* Panels, headers */ --surface-2: #21262d; /* Cards, buttons */ --accent: #58a6ff; /* Primary highlight */ --border: #30363d; /* Subtle dividers */ --text: #e6edf3; /* Primary text */ --text-secondary: #8b949e;/* Secondary text */ } Enhanced Card Styling (Live Example) Card Title This card uses: • --card-bg • --card-border • --card-accent (left bar) • --card-shadow + hover lift Section 2 — Core Key IBK Stacked or Keylight → Despill. Section 3 — Edge & Detail Edge extend / despill mix → Hair restore. Why Use CSS Custom Properties? Single source of truth for theming Easy dark/light mode switching Live updates via JS (try the buttons below) Consistent across editor, nodes, cards, and UI
